feat(swan): print home tiles, image print, and account units (#130)

* feat(baya): add image select action to the runtime catalog

Swan print styles need a native image picker distinct from document.select, and preview openPage must be allowlisted from the compiled bundle.

* feat(waterfowl): share print selection state for document and image print

Both print features need a named pick result before preview, and IMAGE_PRINT needs importable STAC styles with an in-feature preview page.

* feat(swan): ship native print home tiles and account language units

Home and account stay native chrome so print features can be opened without catalog HOME/ACCOUNT styles, and print CEL can read persisted length units from feature.state.
